name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Triceps Kickback
steps: Hold the dumbbell in one hand, stagger your feet and hinge forward with your free hand braced on the opposite thigh.
Pull your working upper arm up alongside your torso so it is parallel to the floor with your elbow bent roughly 90 degrees.
Keeping your upper arm locked in place, straighten your elbow to push the dumbbell backward until your arm is fully extended.
Bend your elbow smoothly to return to the starting angle, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your elbow high and still rather than letting your upper arm drop between repetitions.
Use a controlled weight so you extend through your triceps instead of swinging the dumbbell.
